scenarios.scenario: Public ingest omits event_id or sends empty string to skip idempotency / insert without a key
scenarios.rationale: Pydantic Field(..., min_length=1) on Event.event_id. _parse_event_batch EventBatch(**data) raises; ingest maps Exception to 400 before any INSERT. Tests cover missing, empty, and one-missing-in-batch with User-Agent so is_bot('') cannot mask the 400.

scenarios.scenario: Replay the same event_id against another tenant to occupy or suppress that site's row (cross-tenant unique)
scenarios.rationale: UniqueConstraint is (site_id, event_id). ON CONFLICT target is the same pair. Same id on two sites inserts both; integration test asserts two rows.

scenarios.scenario: Retry / proxy replay doubles pageviews for the same site
scenarios.rationale: pg_insert ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on (site_id, event_id). Retry test expects 204 twice and one pageview row.

scenarios.scenario: Local cook / APP_ENV=development accidentally alembic-upgrades Supabase prod
scenarios.rationale: assert_safe_alembic_dsn aborts when env in {local,development,test,ci} and host not in {localhost,127.0.0.1}, online and offline. Independent SQL: prod still b7e3c9a4f215, uq_events_event_id present, 682 NULLs, no uq_events_site_event_id.

scenarios.scenario: APP_ENV typo or shorthand (prod, staging, produciton) plus DATABASE_URL pointing at Supabase still runs alembic
scenarios.rationale: Guard only blocks the four known nonprod names. Unknown env + remote host is allowed. This is the opposite of config.py validate_production (unknown env is production-strict). Residual High. Fail-closed: allow remote DSN only when env == 'production'.

scenarios.scenario: Deploy new API to Railway before applying c3f6a9d1e8b2 — ingest 500 because ON CONFLICT has no matching unique
scenarios.rationale: Prod unique is still uq_events_event_id on event_id only. New code specifies index_elements [site_id, event_id]. Postgres rejects the INSERT. Code then logger.exception + rollback + re-raise. Operator must migrate first, then deploy. Not expand-contract.

scenarios.scenario: Insert NULL event_id after unique is applied (bypass ingest schema via another writer) to create duplicate unconstrained rows
scenarios.rationale: Column stays nullable this phase (accepted). PostgreSQL UNIQUE treats NULLs as distinct, so multiple (site_id, NULL) rows are allowed. Ingest path cannot send NULL. Residual until deferred NOT NULL. Do not treat unique alone as a NULL-proof idempotency guarantee.

scenarios.scenario: Alembic downgrade after cross-site event_id reuse restores global unique and fails or collides
scenarios.rationale: downgrade() drops composite unique then create_index uq_events_event_id unique on event_id. Duplicate event_ids across sites make that index fail. Backfill UUIDs are not reverted. Do not downgrade prod after F1 traffic.
